levels.B: Agent decides, human approves above limit

policies.title: Duplicate threshold
policies.text: Compare a request with existing records. At 0.95 or above, treat it as the same customer and link it. From 0.80 to below 0.95, a data steward decides. Below 0.80, create a new customer.
rows: Link to existing record; add new sales areas only
Hold for review with the candidates side by side
Create a new customer; keep related records as references
policies.exceptions: Same address with a different tax ID is handled by MM-007a, not by score alone.

policies.title: Ownership change at a known site
policies.text: When a request matches an existing record at the same site with a different tax ID, and D&B reports an ownership change in the last 12 months, do not merge. Create a new customer and link it to the old one as its successor. Copy the ship-to address and delivery instructions. Send credit limit and payment terms to Credit for a fresh decision. Deactivate the old record after 30 days if it has no open orders.
rows: Match score 0.80 or above, address exact, tax ID differs, ownership change within 365 days
Create new customer; link as successor
Old record with open sales orders
policies.exceptions: No ownership change reported: the request goes to a data steward.

policies.title: Source trust order
policies.text: Each attribute of the Business ready record takes the value from its most trusted source. Where sources disagree, the higher-ranked source wins and the decision is recorded with this policy.
policies.exceptions: A value that fails validation never wins, whatever the source rank.

policies.title: Customer payment terms
policies.text: A new customer gets Net 30. Longer terms are allowed only when credit tier, customer type and contract support them. Terms outside the table go to a person.
rows: Credit tier A, limit up to $50,000, 12+ months trading
Credit tier A or B, signed contract, limit up to $250,000
Contract names the terms (government, hospital system, GPO)
Business under 12 months old, or no D&B score
policies.exceptions: Early-pay discounts follow the contract. Terms are never carried to a successor record (MM-007a).

policies.title: Payment method
policies.text: Electronic payment (ACH) is the default. Check and wire are used only for the reasons below. Bank details must pass account validation before any electronic method is set.
rows: Account validation RED, or no bank details
Customer asks for check without a reason
Single payment above $250,000, or foreign bank
policies.exceptions: A change of bank details on an existing customer always needs a call-back to a known contact.

policies.title: Credit limit approvals
policies.text: The Credit agent proposes a limit from the D&B score, trading history and parent exposure. The limit is approved at the level below. Children of a parent share the parent's limit.
rows: Credit manager and BU finance director
No D&B score, or score class 5
Prepay terms; limit set by Credit
policies.exceptions: A limit reset after an ownership change always goes to Credit (MM-007a).

policies.title: Tax status and resale certificates
policies.text: A customer buying for resale is tax-exempt only with a valid resale certificate for the ship-to state. Without one, the customer is taxable and a person is asked to collect the certificate.
rows: Resale certificate present, state matches ship-to, not expired
Certificate state differs from ship-to state
policies.exceptions: Government and non-profit exemptions need a person to review the document.

policies.title: Agreements and compliance acknowledgements
policies.text: A customer is active only after the standard terms of sale and the compliance acknowledgement are accepted. Standard terms are accepted by the agent. Any change to the terms goes to Legal.
rows: Customer in a jurisdiction outside the standard terms

policies.title: Pricing group
policies.text: The pricing group follows the customer type and contract. A customer with no contract gets the standard group for its type. A named contract or GPO membership sets the group the contract names.
rows: Hospital or health system with an IDN contract
Contract found but group not named
policies.exceptions: Special price lists always go to the pricing team.

policies.title: Partner functions
policies.text: A new customer gets sold-to, bill-to and payer set to the same account, with one ship-to. Separate bill-to or payer accounts need a named parent and approval from the parent.
rows: Site in a corporate family, parent confirms billing
Bill-to and payer at the parent
policies.exceptions: Additional ship-tos are added by request, not inferred.

policies.title: Pharmacy licensure and controlled substances
policies.text: Before a pharmacy or other dispenser can order, we verify a valid state license and, for controlled substances, an active DEA registration for the schedules it will order. Trading partners must be licensed or registered for their role under the Drug Supply Chain Security Act.
rows: State license active and DEA active for requested schedules
DEA or state license lapsing within 60 days
License expired, suspended or not found
Ship-to is a PO box and controlled items are requested
policies.exceptions: Exclusion-list hits (OIG, SAM, OFAC) block the customer until a person clears them.

policies.title: Supplier onboarding information
policies.text: For each supplier type, the BPO collects a fixed set of information before the request is accepted. The Procurement agent checks completeness and sends the BPO a list of what is missing.
rows: Legal name, tax ID (W-9 or W-8), address, contact, bank details with voided check or bank letter
Plus FDA establishment registration or state wholesale license
Plus insurance certificate and signed code of conduct
Plus W-8, local registration and sanctions screening evidence
policies.exceptions: Sole-source suppliers go to a category manager before onboarding.

policies.title: Autonomy matrix
policies.text: Every policy has one autonomy level. When no policy covers a decision, the request goes to a person. Levels: Agent decides; Agent decides and a human approves above a limit; Human decides.
rows: Agent acts and logs the decision with its policy
B – Agent decides, human approves above limit
Agent acts up to the limit; above it the request waits
Agent prepares the case; a person decides
Route to a person; log the gap for governance
policies.exceptions: Changing a policy's level needs two approvals.

policies.title: Confidence thresholds
policies.text: Each agent scores its output from 0 to 1. Scores at or above the auto line proceed; scores in the review band go to a person; scores below it are rejected or sent back.
rows: Auto at 0.95+; requester confirms 0.75–0.95; steward below 0.75
Auto at 0.95+; steward 0.80–0.95; new record below 0.80
policies.exceptions: A stage that fails twice stops for a person.

policies.title: Citations and audit
policies.text: Every decision an agent takes records the policy IDs it used, the inputs it saw and the outcome. Screens show the policy on hover, and the full trail is kept in the audit log.
rows: Policy ID, version, inputs, outcome, time
Logged as a gap; routed to a person
